findings.summary: Federal credit in the model is higher than 20% of QRE
findings.claims_compared: DOC-05 shows a federal credit of $5,120,000 on QRE of 24,600 ($ in thousands). DOC-06 certifies QRE of $24,600,000 and a credit of $4,920,000.
findings.explanation: 20% of $24,600,000 is $4,920,000. The model overstates the credit by $200,000.
